mapper.sql: id, account_id, verification_id, public_id, code_hash, product_id, product_revision, quantity, seat_count, subject_mode, bound_member_id, inventory_ticket_id, inventory_quantity, inventory_state, status, issued_at, expires_at, revoke_source, issued_by, request_id, request_fingerprint, revoke_reason, revoke_request_id, revoke_requested_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into marketing_channel_voucher (account_id, verification_id, public_id, code_hash, product_id, product_revision, quantity, seat_count, subject_mode, bound_member_id, inventory_ticket_id, inventory_quantity, inventory_state, status, issued_at, expires_at, revoke_source, issued_by, request_id, request_fingerprint, revoke_reason, revoke_request_id, revoke_requested_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{accountId}, #{verificationId}, #{publicId}, #{codeHash}, #{productId}, #{productRevision}, #{quantity}, #{seatCount}, #{subjectMode}, #{boundMemberId}, #{inventoryTicketId}, #{inventoryQuantity}, #{inventoryState}, #{status}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokeSource}, #{issuedBy}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{revokeReason}, #{revokeRequestId}, #{revokeRequestedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select from marketing_channel_voucher where id = #{id} for update
select from marketing_channel_voucher where public_id = #{publicId} for update
select from marketing_channel_voucher where account_id = #{accountId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update marketing_channel_voucher set status = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 0 and (expires_at is null or expires_at > #{updateTime})

update marketing_channel_voucher set revoke_reason = #{reason}, revoke_request_id = #{requestId}, revoke_requested_at = #{requestedAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 1 and revoke_requested_at is null
mapper.select: select count(*) as voucherCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as redeemedCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now()) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as activeVoucherCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as revokedVoucherCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unredeemedCount from marketing_channel_voucher where account_id = #{accountId} and create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to}

select 'VERIFIED_WITHOUT_VOUCHER' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, null as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, v.status as status, v.create_time as occurredAt from marketing_channel_order_verification v left join marketing_channel_voucher c on c.verification_id = v.id where v.account_id = #{accountId} and v.status = 1 and c.id is null and v.create_time >= #{from} and v.create_time < #{to} union all select 'VOUCHER_UNREDEEMED' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, c.public_id as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, c.status as status, c.create_time as occurredAt from marketing_channel_voucher c join marketing_channel_order_verification v on v.id = c.verification_id where c.account_id = #{accountId} and c.status = 0 and (c.expires_at is null or c.expires_at > now()) and not exists (select 1 from marketing_channel_redemption r where r.voucher_id = c.id) and c.create_time >= #{from} and c.create_time < #{to} union all select 'REDEMPTION_REVOKED' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, c.public_id as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, r.status as status, r.revoked_at as occurredAt from marketing_channel_redemption r join marketing_channel_voucher c on c.id = r.voucher_id join marketing_channel_order_verification v on v.id = c.verification_id where c.account_id = #{accountId} and r.status = 1 and r.revoked_at >= #{from} and r.revoked_at < #{to} union all select 'REDEEMED_WITHOUT_AUTHORITY' as issueType, v.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, c.public_id as voucherPublicId, v.amount as amount, r.status as status, r.redeemed_at as occurredAt from marketing_channel_redemption r join marketing_channel_voucher c on c.id = r.voucher_id join marketing_channel_order_verification v on v.id = c.verification_id where c.account_id = #{accountId} and r.status = 0 and r.registration_id is null and r.redeemed_at >= #{from} and r.redeemed_at < #{to} union all select 'REFUND_PENDING_MANUAL' as issueType, f.channel_order_no as channelOrderNo, null as voucherPublicId, f.amount as amount, f.status as status, f.create_time as occurredAt from marketing_channel_refund_verification f where f.account_id = #{accountId} and (f.status = 2 or (f.status = 1 and f.consumed = 0)) and f.create_time >= #{from} and f.create_time < #{to} order by occurredAt desc limit #{limit}
